title: Moiety
summary: MOI'ETY, noun [Latin medietas.] The half; one of two equal parts; as a moiety of an estate, of goods or of profits; the moiety of a jury or of a nation.

inlines.v: MOI'ETY, noun [Latin medietas.] The half; one of two equal parts; as a moiety of an estate, of goods or of profits; the moiety of a jury or of a nation.
